title: millrace hartnett verified income
instruction:
You are Hilde Ferreira, the Millrace Systems developer who owns the per-play royalty pipeline behind Kilnbrook Media’s music library. Aurelio Hartnett’s mortgage underwriter has rejected his self-service royalty statements and wants a certified monthly earnings history that someone close to the calculation can stand behind. Bohdan Dunbar has assembled the play history, rate material, track and entity references, verification requirements, and Kilnbrook’s partially completed verified-income template in `Hartnett_verified_income_source.xlsx`. Please use that workbook to return one completed file named `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx`, written at the top level of the working directory you start in using exactly that filename. The history must cover the full period provided in the template and must show what Hartnett actually earned after retry-generated plays are removed; the underwriter does not want questionable months averaged, smoothed, or silently replaced. Please complete the workbook as follows: (1) populate the verified-income schedule with one line for every required calendar month, showing the statement amount, corrected amount, removed-play count, inflation amount, and the template’s month status; (2) apply the retry determination in Kilnbrook’s supplied operating material consistently to the full play population, including the row-level exceptions recorded in the notes, and use the supplied effective rates, track ownership, paying entity, and jurisdiction information when rebuilding earnings; (3) complete the play-review area so every play removed from Hartnett’s earnings is traceable to its source event and decision basis, while plays that do not meet the supplied rule remain in earnings; (4) make the March 2019 example reviewable without searching the full export by identifying the flagged play and the neighbouring play that was retained, and state precisely why their outcomes differ; (5) complete the annual and full-period controls so they reconcile to the monthly schedule and the reviewed play population rather than to any pre-existing analyst check; (6) complete the template’s comparison of the verified-income requirements for England and Wales and for Scotland, recording whether this workbook meets each supplied requirement and noting any substantive difference between the two; and (7) complete the certification block using the wording and as-of date already provided for the pipeline owner, but leave fields reserved by the template for the underwriter or a later reviewer untouched. Keep the Basis Note to one printed page. It should give a peer reviewer enough information to reproduce the result, including the retry test, the treatment of note-based exceptions, how identifiers were matched across the supplied material, the March 2019 boundary example, and the basis for the jurisdiction conclusions. Do not introduce estimates, external rates, or unsupported personal details. Before returning the workbook, make sure its labels, totals, review decisions, jurisdiction statements, and certification agree with one another and that no visible spreadsheet error has been carried into the completed file.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Hartnett_verified_income_source.xlsx` — Contains the line-level play history, royalty rates, track and entity references, verification requirements for England and Wales and Scotland, and Kilnbrook Media's partially completed verified-income workbook.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Hartnett_verified_income_certified.xlsx` — Completed certified monthly earnings workbook, including the play review, controls, jurisdiction comparison, certification, and one-page Basis Note. (Place the file at the top level of the working directory using the exact filename. Use the supplied Kilnbrook template and its prescribed output vocabulary. Cover the entire supplied period, retain source traceability, leave template-reserved fields blank, and fit the Basis Note to one printed page.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

sheets.name: Basis Note
rows:
Data basis: Play_History events were matched to Track_Register and Entity_Reference by trimming trailing spaces and comparing keys case-insensitively. Hartnett payable shares and effective-dated rates from Royalty_Rates were applied by play date, paying entity, jurisdiction and track classification. Statement earnings are the source-system amounts before correction; corrected earnings retain eligible plays only.

Retry test: sort by Play Time then Event ID. Remove a later event when normalized session, track, device and jurisdiction match the immediately preceding event and elapsed time is at most 30 seconds (inclusive). Notes override the test: “KEEP_OVERRIDE: separate genuine play” forces Keep; “REMOVE_OVERRIDE: confirmed retry” forces Remove. Removed events are listed once in Play Review with their source ID, timestamp and basis.

March 2019 boundary: EV-MAR-RETRY at 10:00:30 shares the normalized retry keys with EV-MAR-BASE at 10:00:00, so the inclusive 30-second boundary removes it. EV-MAR-KEEP at 10:01:01 is 31 seconds later, so it is retained; the one-second difference explains the opposing outcomes.

Controls: Monthly values are rounded to £0.01 for presentation; annual and full-period controls sum the monthly schedule. Inflation equals statement minus corrected, and status is Corrected if removed plays or positive inflation exists. The jurisdiction comparison reproduces every supplied England and Wales and Scotland requirement; both checklists are met, with Scotland’s additional explicit Scottish paying-entity requirement noted.

semantic_sources: A complete line-level play export for the full nine-year verification period, at approximately the scenario's enterprise-scale volume.
An effective-dated royalty rate schedule covering every combination required by the play data.
A track and ownership register that establishes Hartnett's payable share and track classification.
An entity and jurisdiction reference covering Kilnbrook's relevant paying entities and the named jurisdictions.
A verification-requirements source for England and Wales and for Scotland, including the local certification conventions.
A partially completed verified-income template containing the required output vocabulary, controls, certification fields, jurisdiction comparison, play review, and Basis Note area.

deterministic_business_logic.scope: Include play lines attributable to Hartnett through the supplied ownership register and otherwise eligible under the supplied play fields. Apply the effective royalty rate using play date, paying entity, jurisdiction, track classification, and all other rate dimensions present in the source.
deterministic_business_logic.key_matching: Reference keys are compared case-insensitively after removing trailing whitespace. Seed several valid joins whose only differences are letter case or trailing spaces across the play, track, entity, and rate material. All such keys have exactly one normalized match.
deterministic_business_logic.retry_rule: The operating material defines a retry as a later event that, after chronological ordering by timestamp and stable event identifier, has the same normalized session, track, device, and jurisdiction keys as the immediately preceding source event and occurs no more than a build-agent-chosen threshold of seconds later. The threshold must be a literal value not used in the prompt. This is an explicit inclusive boundary rule.
deterministic_business_logic.notes_override: The play export contains a free-text Notes column. Seed both directions of exception: wording that confirms a separate genuine play which must be kept despite satisfying the main retry test, and wording that confirms a retry which must be removed despite failing the main retry test. The supplied operating material states that these note instructions override the main columns. Use stable, recognizable phrases and include those phrases in the source policy or template legend.
deterministic_business_logic.monthly_values: Statement earnings are the source-system amounts before retry correction. Corrected earnings are the sum of payable royalties for retained events. Monthly removed-play count is the distinct count of excluded source event identifiers. Inflation is statement earnings minus corrected earnings. A month is assigned the template's correction status if and only if it has at least one removed event or positive inflation.
deterministic_business_logic.controls: Annual controls are sums of constituent monthly values. Full-period controls are sums of all months or annual controls. Money is rounded to currency precision only at the monthly presentation layer; reference calculations retain sufficient line-level precision.
deterministic_business_logic.certification: The template supplies the exact declaration wording, signer role, fixed as-of date, and field labels. Hilde Ferreira is the permitted pipeline-owner signer. Fields explicitly labeled for underwriter or later-reviewer use must remain blank.
deterministic_business_logic.jurisdictions: Supply complete, internally consistent verification checklists for England and Wales and for Scotland. Include common requirements and at least one substantive difference that can be faithfully compared from the supplied text. Both assessments must be decidable from the completed workbook without external legal research.

seeded_layout_defects.free_text_notes_override: Place per-row exception instructions in the Notes column while the ordinary structured fields continue to indicate the unmodified automated outcome. Include both keep and remove overrides.
seeded_layout_defects.residual_formula_error: Leave one prior analyst formula error in a non-authoritative legacy control cell within the partially completed template. Label its surrounding area as a prior or legacy analyst check through normal workplace context, while the authoritative source areas remain complete. The gold must ignore this cell and rebuild controls from play-level facts; the submitted workbook must not propagate the error.
seeded_layout_defects.case_and_trailing_space_keys: Vary a subset of otherwise valid join keys only by capitalization or trailing whitespace across source areas. Do not introduce missing, ambiguous, or many-to-many normalized matches.

boundary_case.march_2019: Create adjacent March 2019 events with the same normalized retry keys and no note override. One event falls exactly on the inclusive retry threshold and must be removed; the neighbouring event falls one second beyond the threshold and must be retained. Ensure their identifiers and timestamps are suitable for explicit discussion in the Basis Note.

required_outputs: Monthly fields for statement earnings, corrected earnings, removed-play count, inflation amount, and month status.
A play-review area with source event identifier, play time, final decision, and decision basis.
A comparison area for England and Wales and Scotland.
A certification block and explicitly reserved blank fields.
A Basis Note area configured for a one-page professional note.

authoring_plan.data_quality_boundaries: Inputs must otherwise be complete and mutually consistent. Do not add missing values, unexplained duplicate business records, mixed units, hidden graded data, merged-header traps, floating-point noise traps, conflicting dates, ambiguous effective periods, or any other standard input defect. Retry-like events are intentional business events to classify, not accidental duplicate rows.

gold_derivation.implementation: Use an offline reference script to read the workbook, normalize keys, construct unique reference joins, sort play events, apply the inclusive retry rule, apply Notes overrides, determine Hartnett eligibility and share, select effective rates, compute line royalties, and aggregate monthly, annual, and full-period outputs.
validation: Assert every normalized reference key has exactly one match.
Assert every source event receives exactly one final keep or remove decision.
Assert all note overrides reverse the ordinary rule outcome in their stated direction.
Assert the March 2019 boundary pair produces opposing expected decisions.
Assert corrected plus inflation equals statement earnings within one penny for every month.
Assert jurisdiction conclusions are supported by the supplied checklists.
Generate a reference workbook, render it offline, and walk every rubric item before setting the pass flag.

reference_files.purpose: Contains the line-level play history, royalty rates, track and entity references, verification requirements for England and Wales and Scotland, and Kilnbrook Media's partially completed verified-income workbook.
reference_files.discovery: Use the attached workbook named in the request as the sole factual source and template.

deliverables.description: Completed certified monthly earnings workbook, including the play review, controls, jurisdiction comparison, certification, and one-page Basis Note.
constraints: Place the file at the top level of the working directory using the exact filename. Use the supplied Kilnbrook template and its prescribed output vocabulary. Cover the entire supplied period, retain source traceability, leave template-reserved fields blank, and fit the Basis Note to one printed page.
